questions.question:
Which two signs and two numbers should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

8 + 15 - 20 × 10 ÷ 5 = 47
questions.solution:
8 + 15 - 20 × 10 ÷ 5 = 47

Interchanging + and -, 8 and 15

15 - 8 + 20 × 10 ÷ 5 (according to BODMAS rule)

= 15 - 8 + 20 × 2

= 15 – 8 + 40

= 55 - 8

= 47

Hence, the correct answer is + and -, 8 and 15.

questions.question: What was the day of the week on 26 January 2012?
questions.solution:
Number of odd days till 2011 = no. of odd days in 2000 years (century leap year) + no. of odd days from 2001 to 2011 = 0 odd days + (11 odd days + 2 odd days (as there are 2 leap years)) = remainder of 13 ÷ 7 = 6

Number of odd days up to 26 January 2012 = remainder of 26 ÷ 7 = 5

Total odd days = 5 + 6 = 11 = remainder of 11 ÷ 7 = 4.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(25, 49, 37)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

(25, 49, 37) → 25 + 49 = 74 and 74 ÷ 2 = 37

Similarly,

(6, 4, 5) → 6 + 4 = 10 and 10 ÷ 2 = 5

Hence, the correct answer is (6, 4, 5).

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by four conclusions numbered I, II III and IV. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement:**

No carrot is roof.

All roofs are potatoes.

**Conclusions:**

I. No carrot is potatoes.

II. No potatoes is carrot.

III. Some potatoes are roofs.

IV. All the potatoes are roofs.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48e0f7271543cba7c440e46fc0011240882d91d383d88c2db141f5d3ecf1d288.png] 

**Explanation:**

I. No carrot is potatoes - False (it is possible but not definite)

II. No potatoes is carrot. – False (it is possible but not definite)

III. Some potatoes are roofs. – True (all roofs are potatoes)

IV. All the potatoes are roofs. – False (it is possible but not definite)

Hence, only conclusion III follows.

questions.question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

7, 9, 12, 17, 24, 35, ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

7 + 2 = 9

9 + 3 = 12

12 + 5 = 17

17 + 7 = 24

24 + 11 = 35

35 + 13 = 48

Here 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, and 13 are consecutive prime numbers.

Hence, 48 is the correct answer.

questions.solution:

Similarly,

(11, 18, 27) → 11 + 7 = 18; 18 + 9 = 27

Hence, (11, 18, 27) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
A paper sheet is made into the following pattern (A). Find the cube that will best represent after folding the paper (A).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11ffab2d9b6203e053f37b793009db693fd32a4878d6f5912daa2061aa9fcbb1.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75d570966ad60fd0abbb6d7a24e261c40ec3c8ed6475355a0ba2e7fc785e93e2.png]
questions.solution:
The semicircle in figure 1 should be horizontal. Therefore, figure 1 cannot be formed and options 3 and 4 get eliminated.

As 4 plain faces are available, figure 4 can be formed.

Therefore, option 2 gets eliminated.

By rotating figure 1, we can obtain figures 2 and 3.

Hence, only figures 2, 3 and 4 can be formed.
